title: Saronic mono button
description: A 48px (or 32px) small-radius button with a mono capital label and a thin arrow, turn-down arrow or external-link icon: sonar-lime, a translucent veil for over media, or a 10% ink tint for lime surfaces. On hover it grows 2%, the label rolls up and back in from below, and the arrow nudges right.
notes: CSS only; the grow, roll and nudge are off under reduced motion
optional shortLabel shows below md (e.g. Specs for Specifications)
name: saronic-button

props.name: children
props.description: the label; set in mono capitals

props.name: shortLabel
props.description: a shorter label for phones (e.g. "Specs" for "Specifications")

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary (lime), secondary (veil over media) or tint (on a lime surface)

props.name: icon
props.description: the icon after the label: arrow, down (a turn-down arrow, for in-page jumps), external, or none

props.name: size
props.description: md: the 48px button · sm: the 32px chip used in the announcement bar
